name: Brother Tours — Tour-Only Website Migration and SEO Program
business_model_detail: Laos-based tour operator selling tour packages and related tour-planning services to international travelers

owners.approval: Brother Tours authorized approver — name missing

included: Complete live and staging URL, sitemap, indexability, content, internal-link and technical audit
Page-level migration decisions and redirect mapping
SEOISTIC configuration and idempotent Brother Tours setup seeder
Metadata, canonicals, robots, sitemaps, redirects, breadcrumbs and 404 handling
TravelAgency, WebSite, WebPage, BreadcrumbList and eligible tour schema generated from verified data
AEO/GEO answer blocks, entity clarity, visible FAQs and E-E-A-T evidence
Priority tour and destination optimization for US, UK and European travelers
WordPress theme, template, plugin, form, mobile, accessibility, cache and Core Web Vitals QA
Launch validation and post-launch Search Console monitoring
excluded: Standalone sale of visa processing, accommodation booking, ticketing, rentals, private driver hire or guide-only services
Fake US or European business locations, NAP or doorway pages
Fabricated prices, availability, reviews, ratings, expertise, licenses or customer outcomes
Public publishing, bulk redirects, schema deployment or production changes without approval

access_matrix.purpose: inventory content, plugins, settings, redirects and authoritative URL state
audit, repair, configure and run pre-launch QA
preserve clicks, queries, backlinks, indexed pages and migration signals

access_matrix.required_access: read access or landing-page and conversion exports
access_matrix.purpose: protect high-value landing pages and establish conversion baseline
redirects, cache, headers, staging protection and launch controls
NAP, founding year, licenses, hours, profiles, schema and E-E-A-T

evidence_policy.rule: Keep observed evidence, reproducible calculations, hypotheses and best-practice checks separate. Do not invent traffic, rankings, revenue, backlink or Core Web Vitals data.

initial_issue_register.evidence: The live site exposes legacy service, personnel, landing, paginated taxonomy and multiple tour/destination URL structures, while the staging architecture uses a different tour-only structure.
initial_issue_register.action: Create a page-level keep, merge, 301, 404 or 410 migration map using crawl, sitemap, GSC, GA4 and backlink evidence.
initial_issue_register.acceptance: Every discovered legacy URL has one reviewed action and valid target; no redirect chains, loops, irrelevant homepage redirects or orphaned high-value pages.
initial_issue_register.dependency: Full crawls plus GSC, GA4 and backlink exports

initial_issue_register.evidence: Staging was not found in normal search results, but its exact authentication, robots, meta robots and X-Robots-Tag behavior has not been directly verified.
initial_issue_register.action: Verify staging protection and keep it non-indexable until the approved launch event.
initial_issue_register.acceptance: Staging requires authentication or returns crawlable noindex as designed; production is not accidentally blocked; launch checklist contains the exact unblock step.

initial_issue_register.evidence: The supplied site materials conflict on founding year, email addresses, phone number and operating-history claims, including a placeholder telephone number and an email typo.
initial_issue_register.affected_scope: Sitewide footer/header, contact/about pages, metadata and entity schema
initial_issue_register.action: Obtain one client-approved business fact sheet and use it as the authoritative NAP/entity source.
initial_issue_register.acceptance: Visible business data and JSON-LD match the approved facts everywhere; no placeholders, typos, fake locations or conflicting founding claims remain.
initial_issue_register.owner: Brother Tours authorized approver — name missing
initial_issue_register.dependency: Verified legal and public business facts

initial_issue_register.evidence: Theme links reference destination slugs the seeder does not create, and privacy/terms/cancellation links use conflicting slug systems.
initial_issue_register.affected_scope: Navigation, footer, destination and legal pages
initial_issue_register.action: Choose one canonical slug for each destination and legal page, fix template links and add reviewed redirects from valid legacy alternatives.
initial_issue_register.acceptance: All navigation/footer links return 200; canonical slugs are unique; legacy alternatives resolve with one-hop 301 redirects where appropriate.

initial_issue_register.evidence: SEOISTIC tour schema may output an Offer without a verified price and LimitedAvailability regardless of actual availability; the entity graph is incomplete for the intended travel business.
initial_issue_register.action: Generate schema conditionally from verified page data and connect Tour/Trip entities to the verified TravelAgency provider and destinations.
initial_issue_register.acceptance: Representative pages pass schema syntax checks; no invented or empty commercial properties are emitted; visible content supports all structured data.

initial_issue_register.evidence: Filtered tour URLs are indexable by default and paginated archive canonical behavior requires validation.
initial_issue_register.action: Define crawl/index rules for parameters and pagination without blocking useful discovery or canonical signals.
initial_issue_register.acceptance: Approved archive pages are indexable and self-canonical; non-search filter combinations do not create crawlable index bloat; pagination links remain usable.
initial_issue_register.dependency: Rendered staging crawl and approved archive strategy

initial_issue_register.evidence: The 38 seeded tours largely use repeated short descriptions, generic itinerary sections, duplicated FAQs and mostly empty pricing.
initial_issue_register.affected_scope: Tour detail templates and seeded tour content
initial_issue_register.action: Replace boilerplate on priority tours with verified, intent-specific itinerary, logistics, seasonality, traveler-fit, safety, booking and local-expertise content.
initial_issue_register.acceptance: Priority tours contain unique, fact-checked content, clear conversion paths, visible FAQs/answers, appropriate internal links and no unsupported claims.
initial_issue_register.dependency: Priority-tour list and client-supplied product facts

initial_issue_register.evidence: SEOISTIC's default llms.txt does not enumerate tour and destination entities.
initial_issue_register.action: Generate a concise custom llms.txt after the canonical tour and destination inventory is approved.
initial_issue_register.acceptance: The file lists only canonical, indexable, useful URLs and contains no staging, filter, duplicate, legal-noise or retired pages.

days_0_30.objective: Lock evidence, scope, URL decisions and launch risks before implementation.
deliverables: Validated live/staging crawl and sitemap inventories
GSC/GA4/backlink/server-log evidence imports where available
Master old-URL to action to new-URL migration map
Approved tour-only architecture and canonical slug register
Verified NAP/entity fact sheet
Prioritized tour/content list and measurement baseline
Implementation tickets with rollback and acceptance tests
days_0_30.exit_gate: No high-value legacy URL, core business fact or indexation control remains undecided.

days_31_60.objective: Repair the staging implementation and prepare unique priority content.
deliverables: Fixed theme/template routes and legal slug consistency
SEOISTIC canonical, robots, sitemap, redirect, 404, breadcrumb and schema fixes
Idempotent Brother Tours SEOISTIC setup seeder
Validated archive/filter/pagination behavior
Optimized priority tour and destination pages
Verified AEO/GEO answer blocks, FAQs, entity and trust signals
Mobile, accessibility, form, cache and Core Web Vitals-sensitive QA
days_31_60.exit_gate: Staging passes representative template tests and all critical/high launch blockers are closed or explicitly accepted.

days_61_90.objective: Launch safely, verify migration signals and stabilize performance.
deliverables: Pre-launch backup and rollback package
Production redirect deployment and one-hop verification
Staging deindex protection retained and production indexing enabled
Production sitemap, canonical, robots and schema validation
Forms, conversions, analytics and key revenue-path smoke tests
Search Console sitemap submission and migration monitoring
Weekly exception brief and 30-day post-launch review
days_61_90.exit_gate: Production revenue paths work, critical SEO signals match the approved map, and monitoring has an owner and next measurement date.

approval_gates: Analytics or Search Console configuration changes
External profile, GBP or outreach actions
